name: christmas_core_star
source: Christmas/solidcraft/christmas_star_core.sc (SolidCraft 0.46; Jan's Christmas_star_core_v1.sc), built by Christmas/solidcraft/core_gen/. Equations and checks: corestar_spec.md

shape._comment: constants of the .sc. Core strut: w half width (each side of the radial plane through the edge), hf depth below the face plane (catch edge), er ridge below the face planes. Plug: tw wall, tf flare wall, zb plug below the catch edge, slit_z arm top above the catch edge, la arm length, sl slit, bp barb height, cr crest, bw barb width, barb_in barb joined this far into the wall. Top window: tg lug thickness, lug depth dg = min(dg_max, kdg * window half width), rope hole dr = min(dr_max, dg / 2); tpl lamp plate, tube_cl lamp plug inside the lugs, sleeve_w E10 sleeve wall; top point: ttp wall, ws open top width, hsl tsl csl sleeve height, wall, clearance, gsp gap between the halves, wsl cable slot. fit_h: pyramid kept on the fit test's short points

lamps._comment: seat: sleeve (E10 holder pushed into a sleeve under the lamp plate, its collar on a 45° seat; holder_l its length) or hole (E27 holder through the plate: body_d below, shade ring top_d on top). envelope: what hangs below the lamp plate, top down, as [diameter, length, clearance]; the last one (the bulb) keeps its clearance from every strut and plug end
